DIRECTOR_EVENTS.consequence: Food scarcity tests growth choices and the wellbeing of settlements.

DIRECTOR_EVENTS.consequence: Damaged buildings and routes create a need for reconstruction and relief.

DIRECTOR_EVENTS.consequence: Materials and energy can support growth or a new strategic investment.

DIRECTOR_EVENTS.name: A speculative fever
DIRECTOR_EVENTS.description: A digital-asset mania draws wealth and attention.
DIRECTOR_EVENTS.consequence: New liquidity comes with political discontent and diverted investment.

DIRECTOR_EVENTS.name: Visitors in the sky
DIRECTOR_EVENTS.description: An unexplained encounter challenges what people believe.
DIRECTOR_EVENTS.consequence: A scientific opportunity arrives alongside cultural fascination and disagreement.

DIRECTOR_EVENTS.name: A quiet season
DIRECTOR_EVENTS.description: The world gives civilizations room to act.
DIRECTOR_EVENTS.consequence: Existing projects and pressures unfold without a new shock.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: The first reliable harvest
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Cultivation and working fields have changed how people live. The released settlement systems have produced their first historical transition.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: Beyond the first hearths
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: The expansion feature has become lived history: new communities now support a larger population.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: Roads between peoples
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Working exchanges now connect independent civilizations. Trade is a world fact, not just a newly installed feature.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: The rise of states
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Civic discoveries and functioning exchanges have made organized states possible. Public institutions can now be built.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: A connected world
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Navigation has founded an actual coastal settlement while a working exchange network connects peoples.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: The industrial transformation
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Industrial capability is now supported by an actual productive foundation.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: A planetary civilization
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Information systems and functioning global exchanges have made planetary interdependence real.

HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.name: The interplanetary threshold
HISTORICAL_MILESTONES.explanation: Interplanetary knowledge can now draw on Earth’s connected economy. Launch infrastructure and a viable colony remain separate achievements.

validation.claims: Structural design consistency only. No balance, implementation, live availability or complete legal playthrough is proven.
validation.dependencyWitnesses: Eight named design journeys; full simulation/release/persistence witnesses still required per implementation.

dependencyWitnesses.requiredOutcome: A real paid irrigation beat supports an accepted food export and later partner construction.
The ordinary source-target founding action refuses before capability; the new exact ocean path succeeds with conserved residents after timed construction.
Opening science output changes project throughput while culture independently unlocks a government policy; no stock-only instant research.
Real coal extraction fuels local power and materials; emissions create a visible cost, then renewable investment changes the next allocation.
A unique housed work and actual permitted visits create target-specific tourism, with domestic culture providing defense.
Independent consent, exact later contributions and durable public goods earn political legitimacy; none is inferred from a proposal.

Earth-produced water and propellant bootstrap the first survey and cargo missions; no Mars-only resource is required before Mars is reachable. Uncrewed module manifests carry setup reserves separately from the six-person transit rations; departure requires four beats of landed life-support reserves.
Equipment and upkeep are real; a declared conflict can lose supply, recover through peace and retain surviving residents and city history.

adaptations.adaptation: Independent ten-second actor admission and shared sixty-second strategy replace a global end-turn barrier.
adaptations.reason: One developing or absent model must not stall the inhabited world.

adaptations.adaptation: Six-minute calendar ticks and explicit historical jumps remain separate from strategic production and capability milestones.
adaptations.reason: The owner authorized a real-time, visibly explained world clock.

adaptations.baseline: Productive research turns and visible project estimates
adaptations.adaptation: The narrow proposed correction caps investment by actual current-beat output, available stock and remaining cost. Existing balances and completions are preserved.
adaptations.reason: Live banked science currently makes many newly selected projects finish on the next beat; the diagnosis reproduces this difference.

adaptations.baseline: VI permits switching while retaining project progress
adaptations.adaptation: The current release refuses active replacement. A later explicit switch retains per-node work, rather than resetting or silently accepting replacement.
adaptations.reason: Do not rewrite current order semantics or enable reset spam while introducing the larger catalogue.

adaptations.adaptation: Exact source-town population transfers and voluntary migration conserve residents. The small coast feature resolves founding directly before a later travel layer.
adaptations.reason: Avoid free people and show a real local workforce consequence.

adaptations.adaptation: Current route records are logical exchanges with retained paths and cadence. Later physical cargo has separate departure, transit, blockade and arrival records.
adaptations.reason: A rendered line or recurring receipt must not invent a moving caravan.

adaptations.baseline: VI offers scientific, cultural, military and religious victories; Gathering Storm adds diplomatic victory
adaptations.adaptation: Keep the owner’s five families: Mars, cultural, military, federation and economic. Faith remains meaningful without a separate sixth victory; federation replaces a points-only diplomatic win.
adaptations.reason: Match the requested political/economic world while preserving recognizably Civilization-like competition.

adaptations.baseline: VI base science path culminates in Mars modules
adaptations.adaptation: Require actual conserved colonists, arrivals and sustained locally supported life before victory.
adaptations.reason: Mars is an inhabited destination in a persistent service, not only a completion animation.

adaptations.adaptation: A consulted World Director chooses implemented opportunities, disruption or quiet with explicit evidence and bounded counterplay. New releases enter compatibly.
adaptations.reason: The world grows with development and actual agent decisions.

adaptations.adaptation: Archive the completed world and permit an explicit new run after victory or collapse. No automatic 2050 ending.
adaptations.reason: Preserve a live service and its history without requiring an immortal single world.

designCompleteMeans: Every requested system has named entries and exact proposed inputs, work, outputs, prerequisites and gates.
No dangling dependency or unknown resource reference; research/civic prerequisite graph is acyclic.
Named cross-system journeys include a resource bootstrap and actual useful consequence.
Design, source counterparts and current applied release are clearly separate.
doesNotMean: Any new entry is implemented or activated.
The entire future can already be simulated.
The live prepared pool or spectator outcome is satisfied by this document.
nextPlayableBranch: Actual throughput-capped research with visible before/after progress and retained legacy bank.
The already implemented legal coastal witness, compatible release, a genuine new Navigation choice, timed Boat yard and conserved new-shore founding.
Writing/Mining/Currency and their library/mine/market consequences, followed by separate cultural civics rather than another terminal chain.
acceptance.releaseRule: No technology is applied without its first useful action/building, canonical explanation and persistence. Keep at least two connected available branches plus one fully specified successor branch; a catalogued but unreleased leaf does not satisfy that live outcome.

mechanismBoundaries.implementedPrimitives: Use core/types.ts and the captured runtime catalogue for current behavior. The design effect records are not automatically accepted by that interpreter.
mechanismBoundaries.noPerEntryBranches: A new rule family needs one typed generic interpreter and canonical eligibility/persistence. Content rows then supply validated IDs and quantities.
mechanismBoundaries.boundedWork: Index active projects/routes/units by due beat and affected region. Paginate choices/history losslessly. Retain known existing finite measurements; do not claim new full-catalogue performance without measuring.
